item.title: Bakery Kitchen Workflow 2026: 5-Station Design for 2x Output
item.description: A well-designed bakery kitchen produces meaningfully more output per baker-hour than a poorly designed one — industry operations reports commonly cite 20–40% throughput gains from correct station layout alone. Not because the equipment is fancier, but because the workflow doesn’t force the baker to backtrack, cross-traffic with other stations, or wait for shared tools. Every 15 seconds saved per item compounds — 400 items a day × 15 seconds = 100 minutes daily = a full extra product line’s worth of production capacity, at zero incremental labor cost.
